a.lede: The Bose Noise Cancelling Wired Earbuds are the first new wired headphones from the brand since 2015, inspired directly by teen preferences. We got an early listen.
a.title: Bose Launches New Wired Earbuds After More Than a Decade

b.lede: The new wired USB-C earbuds mix old-school elements with modern audio features.
b.title: Bose’s new wired earbuds aim for the same great sound and ANC – no charging needed
